reason: The directly opened QuickFacts page reports 9.3% uninsured among residents under 65 but does not display the observation year. Census's QuickFacts locator documentation says county estimates for this measure come from SAHIE, while QuickFacts' current SAHIE dataset catalog reaches 2024; however, the exact Monterey County SAHIE row could not be retrieved from the interactive or API reader, so the displayed value's vintage cannot be verified directly. Keep as a dated-source gap rather than assign an inferred year.
